Nina R.: Need a quick preflight check for next week's webinar. Key asks: prerecorded bench clip, customer slide deck, and two launch posts.
Sam H.: Got it. I'll record a 60s bench highlight and include the bench stat for the product post. Will upload to /greenroom/webinars/mar-ops by Thu 5pm.
Jules P.: I'll own the customer post + the confirmation email. Also drafting variants for infra vs PM audiences.
Nina R.: Rehearsals: Wed 9am PT dry run, Thu 10am PT tech check, Fri 2pm PT dress. Please pick one to attend.
Sam H.: I'm good for Wed + Fri. If the live demo flaps, what's fallback?
Nina R.: Fallback: switch to prerecorded bench clip and open chat-only Q&A. greenroom ops will trigger if error rate >2% for 3 min. Host fallback = Jules.
greenroom-bot: Reminder: upload prerecorded fallback to /greenroom/webinars/mar-ops by Thu 17:00 PT. Auto-captions will run after upload.
Jules P.: Action items: Sam record clip (Thu 3pm), Jules draft customer post + emails (Tue EOD), Nina finalize run-of-show and send invites (Mon EOD).
